text: The Fiji Growth and Resilience First Development Policy Financing with a Catastrophe Deferred Drawdown Option (Cat-DDO) is a World Bank-supported initiative aimed at enhancing Fiji's fiscal resilience, private sector development, and climate and disaster resilience. It combines immediate budget support with a pre-arranged contingent credit line for disasters, providing rapid liquidity post-disaster. The operation is aligned with Fiji's reform calendar and cyclone seasons, running through mid-2027.
